Grappled.name: Grappled
Grappled.description: Grappled creatures cannot make voluntary movements. A Grappled creature may take a Brawl: Grapple action to remove the Grappled condition.

Prone.name: Prone
Prone.description: Prone creatures must spend twice as much Speed to move and Melee attacks against them has Boon(1). A Prone creature can use the Move action to remove the condition if their speed is more than 0.
